error[VIBE1102]: The attribute `id` appears more than once on this element.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:2:17
2 |   <input id="a" id="b" v-="x" :[key="y" =z a"b c=d'e>
  |                 ^^^^^^
fix: Remove the second `id`.
fix: Merge both values into one `id` attribute.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1102

error[VIBE1126]: The attribute `v-` is a directive without a name.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:2:24
2 |   <input id="a" id="b" v-="x" :[key="y" =z a"b c=d'e>
  |                        ^
fix: Write the directive name after `v-`, as in `v-if="ok"`.
fix: Remove the attribute.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1126

error[VIBE1127]: The dynamic argument has no closing `]`.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:2:36
2 |   <input id="a" id="b" v-="x" :[key="y" =z a"b c=d'e>
  |                                    ^
fix: Close the argument with `]`.
fix: Remove the spaces from the argument, or compute the name in the script.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1127

error[VIBE1119]: An attribute name starts with `=`.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:2:41
2 |   <input id="a" id="b" v-="x" :[key="y" =z a"b c=d'e>
  |                                         ^
fix: Write the attribute name before `=`, as in `id="main"`.
fix: Remove the extra `=`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1119

error[VIBE1117]: The attribute name contains `"`, which is not allowed in attribute names.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:2:45
2 |   <input id="a" id="b" v-="x" :[key="y" =z a"b c=d'e>
  |                                             ^
fix: Add the missing `=` before the quote of the value.
fix: Add a space between two attributes.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1117

error[VIBE1118]: The unquoted attribute value contains `'`.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:2:51
2 |   <input id="a" id="b" v-="x" :[key="y" =z a"b c=d'e>
  |                                                   ^
fix: Quote the value, as in `name="value"`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1118

error[VIBE1122]: A `/` inside a tag is not followed by `>`.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:3:7
3 |   <div/ ><svg><![CDATA[ok]]></svg><![CDATA[bad]]><?xml?></>
  |       ^
fix: Write `/>` with no space between `/` and `>`.
fix: Remove the `/`, or quote the attribute value that contains it.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1122

error[VIBE1101]: A CDATA section `<![CDATA[ ]]>` is allowed only inside `<svg>` or `<math>`.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:3:35
3 |   <div/ ><svg><![CDATA[ok]]></svg><![CDATA[bad]]><?xml?></>
  |                                   ^
fix: Write the text without `<![CDATA[` and `]]>`, escaping `<` as `&lt;` and `&` as `&amp;`.
fix: Move the CDATA section inside an `<svg>` or `<math>` element.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1101

error[VIBE1121]: `<?` is allowed only inside `<svg>` or `<math>`.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:3:51
3 |   <div/ ><svg><![CDATA[ok]]></svg><![CDATA[bad]]><?xml?></>
  |                                                   ^
fix: Remove the `<?…>` instruction, such as an XML declaration.
fix: Write `&lt;?` for literal text.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1121

error[VIBE1114]: `</>` is an end tag without a tag name.
  --> html/attributes/input.vibe:3:59
3 |   <div/ ><svg><![CDATA[ok]]></svg><![CDATA[bad]]><?xml?></>
  |                                                           ^
fix: Write the name of the element to close, as in `</div>`.
fix: Remove `</>`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1114
